description: Margin used to value a grade sorted out of a bulk hing lot at the counter. Read by the Sales Invoice when a row has Repack from Bulk ticked.

fields.description: The grade billed on the Sales Invoice (B). Created from the bulk lot at the counter, so it should hold no stock of its own.
fields.label: Sold Item

fields.description: The purchased lot it is sorted out of (A). Its whole remaining stock passes through the repack and comes back at the plug rate.
fields.label: Bulk Item

fields.description: Gross margin on the sale price: cost = net rate x (1 - margin %).
fields.label: Margin %

fields.description: Applies to invoices posted on or after this date, until a later rule for the same sold item takes over.
fields.label: Effective From

fields.description: Stock-UOM quantity of the bulk item used for one stock-UOM unit of the sold item. 1 for Kg sold from Kg; 0.05 for a 50 g pack filled from Kg.
fields.label: Bulk Qty per Unit

name: BNS Counter Repack Rule
